Ammunition Bundle

You loosen the binding and feel the familiar shapes waiting for your hand.

Rules

- ID: item-ammunition-bundle - Bulk: 1 - Requirements / supply: Inventory d8 - Acquisition: Explicit ability grant, coins, or DA treasure; no automatic extra starting kit.

Check after each attack that consumes ammunition; on 1 reduce a die step. Last use works. One bundle, not one Bulk per arrow.

No DP price. Purchase does not grant training or an ability.

Equipment index

Market price: 9 coins. Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
